entries.ec24700e137a3c34: Based on the "FY25-27 Medium-Term Management Plan," the company aims to maximize earnings from its core affiliate network business, while expanding investment in its Strategic Business, including the digital marketing support tool suite "N-INE" and the influencer marketing company WAND, Inc., with the stated goal of evolving from a provider of an advertising network into a "prosumer support company" that supports digital marketing in general on an end-to-end basis. The company also states that it is developing the in-house operating system "FANCOMI AI," which integrates its proprietary database with AI, and is promoting the use of AI across sales, operations and back-office functions.
entries.f4777bf4f11a953a: "A8.net" is a network with 3,084 active advertiser IDs and 3,622,301 registered partner sites as of December 31, 2025, and the scale of both advertisers and media forms the basis of matching. "A8app," the CPI advertising service for smartphone apps, is offered on a closed basis, in which dedicated staff match advertising campaigns to partner sites based on their characteristics, and the company states that it enables advertising delivery with high cost-effectiveness.
entries.f9fc464c99fd6309: This business operates the affiliate advertising service “A8.net” and the CPI advertising service for smartphone apps “A8app”. Under this scheme, when purchases, member registrations or other results occur on an advertiser's site, rewards are paid according to those results to partner sites that serve as advertising media; the Company is responsible for calculating the results of each advertisement, collecting advertising fees from advertisers, and paying rewards to partner sites. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥5,660 million.
